G-A1.note: levels cross-section only; scoped to 2018→ (ledger start), spec says 2015→

G-A2.note: one out-of-sample year (2025, quarterly YoY), not the 2016–2024 rolling backtest of the spec

headline.model: quarterly YoY growth calibration (a + β·Δlog lights), σ from national residuals

deseason.weights: w = min(1, coverage/0.6)², zero below 5%; low-coverage flag < 30%

flares.source: Elvidge & Zhizhin (2021), Global Gas Flare Survey by Infrared Imaging, VIIRS Nightfire 2012–2019, ORNL DAAC
flares.licence: NASA EOSDIS data policy: openly shared, without restriction (cite the dataset)
flares.buffer_note: 3 km captures ~84% of an isolated flare's excess light (measured on the 2025 composite); the spec's 5 km swallows whole towns and is kept as a sensitivity column
